build_transformer_model: build a Transformer model with configurable encoder and decoder layers for vision tasks
create_transformer_encoder: create a TransformerEncoder that processes source sequences through stacked encoder layers
create_transformer_decoder: create a TransformerDecoder that generates outputs from memory with optional intermediate activations
review_transformer_encoder_layer: review the TransformerEncoderLayer self-attention and feedforward operations with pre or post normalization
review_transformer_decoder_layer: review the TransformerDecoderLayer self-attention cross-attention and feedforward operations with normalization options
